daily.today_energy: Your mind is electric today, Gemini. There's a restless brilliance flowing through you—lean into it. Skip the small talk and go deep with someone who gets it. Your vibe is magnetic when you're being real.
daily.love: Someone's been watching you from across the room energy. If you're coupled up, your partner feels that confidence radiating off you. Single? Your authenticity is the ultimate love language right now. Trust what you're sensing.
daily.career: Ideas are popping off like crazy today. You're in your element when communicating, so speak up in that meeting. Your perspective matters more than you think. Channel that nervous energy into something creative or strategic.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement—dancing, walking, anything that lets you think while you move. Your nervous system loves rhythm. Hydration is lowkey your secret weapon today. Listen to what your gut's telling you.

weekly.overview: Mercury's direct energy has you feeling chatty and creative this week. Channel that mental clarity into projects that actually excite you. Trust your instincts—they're sharper than usual right now.
weekly.love: Your vibe is irresistible this week. If you're single, meaningful conversations could spark something real. If coupled, vulnerability goes a long way. Stop overthinking and just feel it out.
weekly.career: Ideas are flowing freely, so capture them before they slip away. This is peak networking energy—reach out to people you've been meaning to connect with. Your communication skills are your superpower rn.
weekly.health: Your nervous system appreciates grounding this week. Try something slow and intentional—walks, stretching, journaling. Your energy feels scattered, so anchoring yourself will feel genuinely restorative.
